source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enable Persistence-Mode via cmd: nvidia-smi -pm 1
2. Set Health-Monitor via cmd: dcgmi health -s mpi
3. Check Health-Monitor via cmd: dcgmi health -c
4. Run Health-Test L4 via cmd: dcgmi diag -v -r 4
5. Disable Persistence-Mode via cmd: nvidia-smi -pm 0

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Health-Monitor should show "Healthy".
2. The result of Health-Test L4 should be PASS without errors.

original_test_intent: Configure and verify DCGM health monitoring, execute the complete one-hour Level-4 memory diagnostic on the approved GPUs, retain Healthy/PASS and full memtest evidence within safety limits, and restore the approved final state.
original_method: Validate DCGM/GPU/MIG/workload/memory/ECC/thermal baseline, run the exact persistence enable, health-watch setup/check and verbose run-level-4 workflow under one approved plan, enforce timeout/thermal/ECC Safety Stops, then restore approved persistence/monitor state.
manual_activity: One authorized user approves the unchanged L4 plan, exclusive window, limits and restoration. Commands, live monitoring, Safety Stop and evidence capture are machine-executable; no physical/manual core is inherent.
required_inputs: Approved DCGM/dcgmi, driver, stable GPU target set and L4 support
Baseline/free memory, ECC, temperature, MIG mode, instances and active clients
Exclusive 60-minute window, timeout and thermal/ECC/driver Safety Stop thresholds
Health-watch `mpi` semantics and persistence/monitor baseline/final state
safety_requirements: Ensure selected GPUs are free of protected workloads/MIG clients and have required memory/thermal headroom.
One approval covers only the fixed plan; stop on target/plan deviation, partial setup, timeout, thermal excursion, ECC/driver fault or device loss.
Keep full L4 stdout/stderr, per-test result, duration and concurrent telemetry; never hide original failure.
Do not reset GPUs, kill workloads, restart services/drivers, retry memtest or perform unapproved recovery automatically.
Restore only the explicitly approved final state.
agent_execution_scope: Validate tooling, identity, resource blackout, safety and recovery gates and capture baseline.
Execute all source monitor/persistence steps and exact verbose L4 while collecting memory/ECC/thermal/driver evidence.
Enforce Safety Stop, perform approved final restoration and collect post-health events.
Report Tool Result and deviations without formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve tools, targets, exclusive window, limits, full plan and restoration.
Decide disposition after any Safety Stop, timeout or partial result.
Review complete evidence and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A generic level-4 command may be an alias, but it omits source setup/teardown and critical memtest safety evidence; calling it read-only understates resource impact.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve `dcgmi diag -v -r 4` and every surrounding source step; validate any alias against deployed help and equivalent memtest coverage.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All five steps, `mpi`, verbose L4, criteria, script URL and 2/60-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: SOURCE L4 WORKFLOW RETAINED WITH STRICT MEMTEST SAFETY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a stable per-GPU/DCGM-ID transaction during an exclusive window with memory/ECC/thermal baseline and live limits, full one-hour L4 report, restoration and event correlation.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: DCGM-supported GPUs eligible for L4 memtest with sufficient headroom.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record DCGM/dcgmi, driver, GPU firmware, MIG mode, nvidia-smi, OS/kernel, BMC and workload runtime.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA DCGM diagnostics/health documentation for the deployed release and referenced project script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit exclusivity, safety telemetry, stable identity and restoration without reducing L4 coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; the 60-minute source machine time and full L4 result remain visible.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: L4 resource, timeout and safety policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Memtest may expose errors or impact clients; DCGM PASS is a Tool Result, not the engineer's formal verdict.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve different duration/targets/limits and report that plan completed, but must state the override and cannot claim the original 60-minute/full-target coverage if reduced.
expected_evidence: DCGM/driver versions, stable GPU/MIG/memory/ECC/thermal/workload baseline and approval
Full verbose L4 report, return code, exact runtime and live safety telemetry
Safety-stop record if any, final restoration and post GPU/BMC/OS health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires monitor Healthy and Level-4 PASS. Missing execution limits are project safety inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The L4 operation is clear and automatable when the exclusive window, package and safety plan are approved.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Restores omitted setup/teardown and corrects the misleading read-only characterization with case-specific resource controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains all critical L4 safety/readiness gates while correcting V3.1 classification to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Applies one-plan approval, explicit Safety Stop, project duration override semantics, no retry and engineer-owned verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a one-hour memtest from being treated as a harmless query, while preserving every source step and full failure evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The critical diagnostic, monitoring and recovery-state collection are still software-controlled. With an approved fixed plan they can be automated; high risk does not itself imply PARTIAL.
